text:
Type: geometric jacquard throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, contemporary, mid-century modern
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with textured stitching
Colors: black, light dusty blue, charcoal grey, ivory
Shape: square, all-over mosaic of overlapping triangles and shards, plump, knife edges, medium size
Feel: bold, graphic, energetic
Goes with: grey or blue sofas, white walls, black accents; modern or contemporary living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Mosaic Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Blue
product.description: Bring a bit of retro flair to your bedroom with this mid-century inspired mosaic design. Geometric patterns in blue, black and ivory will add a sophisticated modern touch to your room. For a different look, flip it over to the solid black side. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
